pillars.name: Pillar 7 --- Opinions & Discussions
pillars.objective: Publish thoughtful, defensible opinions that encourage discussion without manufacturing controversy.
example_topics: Every business does not need AI.
Excel is not bad software; businesses often ask it to do jobs it was never designed for.
Buying an ERP does not digitally transform a company.
AI agents will not fix broken processes.
The best business software is often software employees barely notice.
SMEs may not have a data problem; they may have a data-organization problem.
Automation should not always begin with AI.
More software does not necessarily mean better operations.
A dashboard is useless if the underlying data is unreliable.
The best automation sometimes removes a step rather than automating it.
